This is a placeholder first post. The rest of the site (Home / Awards / Projects / Publications) was
migrated from the previous [distill](https://rstudio.github.io/distill/)-based site to
[Quarto](https://quarto.org/), which adds native blog support like this listing page.

To add a real post: create a new folder under `blog/`, add an `index.qmd` with a `title`/`date` in the
frontmatter (same shape as this file), and it shows up here automatically, newest first. Jupyter notebooks
(`.ipynb`) work as posts too, rendered with their real code output — handy for anything code-heavy.
